title: Award Recency Rule for Domestic Main Cabin Awards, Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements
content:
**Rule.** For a domestic Crestline Main Cabin round-trip award redeemed from Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements company points, the days from the latest points redemption on the agreement — of any kind — to the redemption date set the award recency percentage:

| Calendar days since the latest points redemption | Award recency percentage |
|---|---|
| 120 or more | 97 percent |
| 60 or more, and fewer than 120 | 99 percent |
| fewer than 60, or no earlier redemption on file | 100 percent (the listed price) |

**How the percentage acts.** The award recency percentage multiplies the standard domestic award price, the tier's domestic Main Cabin round-trip award points. Where the price carries several such percentages, they are all applied together to the standard price, each divided by one hundred, and the product is rounded to the nearest whole point once.

### Day counts (hypothetical dates, redemption on 30 September)

| Latest earlier redemption | Days | Percentage |
|---|---|---|
| 2 June | 120 | 97 |
| 3 June | 119 | 99 |
| 1 August | 60 | 99 |
| 2 August | 59 | 100 |
| none on file | — | 100 |
